scope: Four sealed market cohorts, monthly expanding fits, three-state classification and seven continuous outcomes
parameter_source: Prior RBF-SVM development lock, positive-weight M+Z winner per market and task

60d.historical_inputs: Original 20d information sets and history dictionary
60d.future_label_rule: 60 trading days after the as-of anchor with a new initial-training-only state dictionary
60d.classification_probability: Fixed unit-temperature softmax of three RBF-SVC OVR scores because original time validation does not cover all states

20d.historical_inputs: Only the sealed macro projection of M+Z
20d.macro_exponent_rule: Use the locked gamma_factor times macro_weight as the single-block gamma_factor
